EQIP Improvement Act of 2025
To amend the Food Security Act of 1985 to make adjustments to the environmental quality incentives program, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

bill.summary:
EQIP Improvement Act of 2025
This bill modifies payment limitations and reduces the federal cost share for certain projects authorized under the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP). As background, this Department of Agriculture program provides technical and financial assistance to agricultural producers and forest landowners to address natural resource concerns.
Specifically, the bill limits the total payments available to a person or legal entity under EQIP to $150,000 over a specified five-year period. (A $450,000 statutory limit was in effect for FY2019-FY2024, and a regulatory contract limit of $450,000 currently applies.)
The bill also reduces the maximum federal cost share to 40% (from 75%) for the costs associated with planning, installation, or maintenance for specified conservation practices (e.g., access roads, dams, and waste storage facilities).
